stories.title: Microsoft 365 Outage Disrupts Outlook, Exchange Online and Teams
stories.description: Microsoft says failed server health checks disrupted Outlook and other Microsoft 365 services. The company is still investigating the cause and has disclosed no evidence of a cyberattack.

stories.title: Webinar: See How Identity Blind Spots Put Your SOC at Risk and How to Close Them
stories.description: Learn how identity context helps SOC teams investigate threats, assess access permissions, and respond to compromised accounts.

stories.title: ThreatsDay: 59 Linux Kernel Bugs, Falcon Spyware, GSocket Backdoors + 17 More Stories
stories.description: This week's ThreatsDay Bulletin covers AI-powered cyberattacks, ransomware, stolen credentials, Linux flaws, browser espionage, and emerging security

stories.title: New SignDrop Zero-Day Exploit Turns Windows CLFS Security Feature Into SYSTEM Access
stories.description: Public SignDrop exploit code abuses Windows CLFS log authentication to enable local SYSTEM privilege escalation, with no Microsoft fix available.

stories.title: Europol Takes Down 235 Servers and 257 Domains Linked to Gootloader, CastleRAT, and StealC Malware
stories.description: Europol and international partners have disrupted infrastructure linked to Gootloader, CastleRAT, and StealC, targeting malware services that support ransomware attacks and data theft.

stories.title: Microsoft Teams Outage Hits Users in North America
stories.description: Microsoft is investigating a Microsoft Teams outage affecting users in North America, with automated recovery measures now reducing the disruption.

stories.title: Critical Red Hat Quay Flaw Lets Attackers Read and Overwrite All Private Container Images in a Registry
stories.description: Red Hat patches two critical Quay flaws enabling registry-wide image access and cross-tenant robot token theft under different prerequisites.

stories.title: When Attackers Move at AI Speed, How Can Your SOC Keep Up?
stories.description: Artificial intelligence is changing the cybersecurity landscape at an unprecedented pace. While enterprises are using AI to improve efficiency, cybercriminals are finding new ways to automate attacks, refine phishing campaigns, and scale their operations.

stories.title: Apache Patches Critical HTTP Server RCE Found by Anthropic, Google
stories.description: The mod_http2 race condition, CVE-2026-119618, could let unauthenticated attackers execute code on servers with HTTP/2 enabled.

stories.title: Chrome, Firefox Updates Patch Over 180 Vulnerabilities
stories.description: Google fixed 83 flaws with a new Chrome 157 release, and Mozilla addressed 99 bugs in Firefox 160.

stories.title: Attacker Targets 60,000 GitHub Repositories in Credential Theft Campaign
stories.description: Using thousands of hijacked accounts, the wfx-loot campaign planted a CI secret stealer that ran in over 1,800 GitHub repositories.

stories.description: Microsoft continues its AI-induced patch surge, addressing 1,260 different vulnerabilities this month. 68 of these vulnerabilities are considered critical. 167 of the vulnerabilities are Chromium issues affecting Microsoft Edge.
